description: Every command with a promise (an async method of src/adapters/NativeANNTurboModule.ts): what it resolves with, whether the navigation state goes before its answer (`state`), and whether `ANN.CommandCompleted` follows the answer (`completed`). scripts/contract.mjs makes ios/Contract/ANNCommandContract.{h,mm} and android/.../react/CommandContract.kt from it, and fails when a command of the spec is missing here or a command here is not in the spec.

commands.name: setRoot
commands.resolves: the id of the root, once the root and the layout's modals and overlays show

commands.name: push
commands.resolves: the id of the screen that shows; of a pair, the pair's id

commands.name: preparePush
commands.resolves: the frame `{ width, height, padding }` of the prepared screen, or null; always null on iOS

commands.name: pop
commands.resolves: the id of the screen that went

commands.name: popTo
commands.resolves: the id of the screen it went back to

commands.name: popToRoot
commands.resolves: the id of the first screen of the stack

commands.name: setStackRoot
commands.resolves: the id of the new top screen

commands.name: showModal
commands.resolves: the id of the modal's root

commands.name: dismissModal
commands.resolves: the id of the modal's root

commands.name: showOverlay
commands.resolves: the id of the overlay's root

commands.name: dismissOverlay
commands.resolves: the id of the overlay's root

commands.name: showInColumn
commands.resolves: the id of the screen that shows

commands.name: setColumnShown
commands.resolves: nothing once the columns stopped moving (`undefined` on iOS, `null` on Android)

commands.name: getLaunchLink
commands.resolves: the link that launched the app, or null
